info.name: International Platform Documentation
info.description:
Getting Started

1. Request Access

Request access for your application by signing up at the developer portal. You will need to sign up separately for each environment below.

Development Environment: https://ntsdev.developer.azure-api.net

Production Environment: https://nts.developer.azure-api.net

2. Verify Your Email

Once you sign up you will receive an email that has a verification link in it. Click through that email link to verify your email address

3. Wait for Subscription Activation & Tenant Id

After you have verified your email address and upon final review by the Web.com International team your account will be granted access to our API. Once we have granted access you will receive an email confirming your active subscription with instructions on how to view and manage your api subscription keys. In addition we will provide you with your Tenant Id which is required to be sent in all api requests via the x-nts-tenant-id http header in addition to your subscription key.

4. Api Endpoint Urls

Each environment has it's own api endpoint url as noted below.

Development Environment: https://api-dev.nts.web.com

Production Environment: https://api.nts.web.com

5. Call the Healthcheck Api

Make sure you can access and successfully call our healthcheck api (see below)

item.description:
Sales Orders

Sales orders capture information about the sale of products to new or existing Customers. They allow you to attribute the sale to a given sales rep (for commission) as well as specify a sales partner (for when you are fulfilling websites on behalf of another company).

Sales orders can go through various pipeline phases so that you can track the progression of the sales funnel as you work with the customers. The pipeline phases are:

  1. Sales Lead - This is the starting point of a sales order when you only have a lead to work with. You can populate the customer information that you know and continue to update the sales order as you move the customer through the sales pipeline.
  2. First Call - You have made contact with the sales lead
  3. Proposal - You have submitted a proposal to the sales lead for purchase.
  4. Sold - The sales lead has agreed to purchase what has been proposed
  5. Waiting for Payment - We are waiting to secure payment from the sales lead
  6. Paid - We have secured payment from the sales lead and are ready to provision services. This is the only sales order status that will trigger provisioning in NTS

You can create sales orders for new or existing customers. If you are working with an existing customer then you can simply supply the customer's email address and NTS can uniquely identify the customer. If you are working with a new customer then you must supply all required customer information so that NTS can create a new customer in the system.

Every customer in NTS has one or more accounts. An account is a container that holds all of the products and services that are purchased and provisioned on a sales order. A customer can have more than one account if they choose. For example, a customer may have one "Business" account where he/she has his company's website, email and ppc service and a second "Personal" account where he/she maintains their personal blog.

Any product that has been configured in your tenant's product catalog can be placed on the sales order. The products can be identified by their product name as that is unique in NTS for your tenant.

Finally, payment information is collected. As of today, this is for informational purposes only as NTS does not integrate with a payment processor. You must secure payment from the customer by other means and then set the status of the sales order to paid in order for it to provision services.
